answer: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, (SELECT MAX(points) FROM driverStandings ds WHERE ds.driverId=d.driverId) AS max_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d USING(driverId) WHERE r.position=1 GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(r.laps=w.laps)/COUNT(*),2) FROM results r JOIN drivers d USING(driverId) JOIN races ra USING(raceId) JOIN results w ON w.raceId=r.raceId AND w.position=1 WHERE d.nationality='Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT SUM(r.points) AS points, co.name, co.nationality FROM results r JOIN races ra USING(raceId) JOIN constructors co USING(constructorId) WHERE ra.name='Monaco Grand Prix' AND ra.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY co.constructorId ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(n),2) FROM (SELECT ra.raceId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pitStops p WHERE p.raceId=ra.raceId) n FROM races ra WHERE ra.year=2017 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM races x WHERE x.year=2000 AND x.name=ra.name))

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying q WHERE q.driverId=d.driverId AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3<>'') AS q3_count FROM drivers d WHERE d.nationality='German' AND substr(d.dob,1,4) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985' ORDER BY q3_count DESC, d.dob

WITH t AS (SELECT d.forename,d.surname,q.q1, CAST(substr(q.q1,1,instr(q.q1,':')-1) AS INT)*60000+CAST(substr(q.q1,instr(q.q1,':')+1,2) AS INT)*1000+CAST(substr(q.q1,-3) AS INT) ms FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d USING(driverId) JOIN races r USING(raceId) WHERE r.year=1995 AND r.name='Japanese Grand Prix' AND q.q1<>'' AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL) SELECT forename,surname,q1 FROM t WHERE ms=(SELECT MIN(ms) FROM t)

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS n FROM results r JOIN races ra USING(raceId) JOIN drivers d USING(driverId) WHERE ra.name='Italian Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder=2 GROUP BY d.forename HAVING n>=2 ORDER BY n DESC, d.forename

SELECT ROUND(1.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d USING(driverId) WHERE d.dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31' AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3<>'')/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31'),2)

WITH f AS (SELECT l.raceId,l.driverId,MIN(l.milliseconds) ms FROM lapTimes l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING MIN(l.milliseconds)<90000) SELECT r.date, d.forename, d.surname, (ms/60000)||':'||printf('%02d',(ms%60000)/1000)||'.'||printf('%03d',ms%1000) AS fastest_lap FROM races r LEFT JOIN f ON f.raceId=r.raceId LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId=f.driverId WHERE r.name='French Grand Prix' AND r.year>=1990 ORDER BY r.date, d.surname, d.forename

SELECT d.forename||' '||d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, ra.name, ra.date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results x WHERE x.driverId=d.driverId) AS races_started FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON r.driverId=d.driverId AND r.position=1 JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=r.raceId WHERE d.driverId=(SELECT d2.driverId FROM drivers d2 JOIN results r2 ON r2.driverId=d2.driverId AND r2.position=1 ORDER BY d2.dob, d2.forename||' '||d2.surname LIMIT 1) ORDER BY ra.date, ra.name LIMIT 1

WITH t AS (SELECT d.surname, ra.name, q.q2, CAST(substr(q.q2,1,instr(q.q2,':')-1) AS INT)*60000+CAST(substr(q.q2,instr(q.q2,':')+1,2) AS INT)*1000+CAST(substr(q.q2,-3) AS INT) ms FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d USING(driverId) JOIN races ra USING(raceId) WHERE ra.year=2017 AND q.q2<>'' AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL) SELECT surname,name FROM t WHERE ms=(SELECT MIN(ms) FROM t)
